objective: Bring Yowler's Paw to Verner Osgood in Lakeshire.

description: <name>, the gnolls are still out there.  I can hear their baying as they hunt in the hills above Lakeshire.  And one cry is louder than the rest - Yowler,  their leader.
Kill Yowler and send his pack scattering!  Bring me his paw as proof.
And be careful, this gnoll is their leader for a reason.  He is no Mongrel...
progress: Yowler is a dangerous creature, <name>. If you're not ready for him, I understand.
completion: Again, thank you for your help. The Stormwind army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
